messages:
Jordan: Quick sync — trying to finish onboarding Aurelius-7B. Need final gating checklist re: licensing & tokenizer issues. Weights uploaded to S3, see:
```
s3://redwood-models/aurelius/7b/v1/aurelius-7b-weights.pth
s3://redwood-models/aurelius/7b/v1/tokenizer.model
```
Anyone from legal/security available? :eyes:

Elaine: From legal: we need a model_card.md + a LICENSE file (explicit license text). Confirm whether commercial use allowed or restricted. Also need training-data provenance note (high-level ok).

Sahil: Quick infra note — weights look fine. Tokenizer quirk: the shipped sentencepiece has unk_id=0 but our runtime expects unk_id=3. That causes early <unk> spikes in decoding. Also emoji handling is noisy; a few emojis map to <unk>.

Jordan: @Sahil can you paste the minimal patch or a mapper? Also prefer a converter script checked into repo.

Sahil: sure, adding the mapping in tokenizer.json should be enough. example snippet:
```
{
  "unk_id": 3,
  "bos_id": 1,
  "eos_id": 2
}
```
I'll open a PR with a small wrapper that normalizes ids on load.

Ava: Security checklist: please run export-control scan + PII/secret-leak tests (model-embed-privacy). We also need artifact KMS policy validated for the S3 bucket before private deployment. Flagging for security review.

LicensingBot: Automated license-scan report: found 2 issues — missing attribution line in model_card.md and ambiguous clause regarding commercial use (requires explicit yes/no). See: https://license-scan.local/report/1772009999 :robot_face:

Elaine: I'll draft the attribution text and update model_card.md. Need someone to add a short "usage restrictions" section (examples: no biometric surveillance, no targeted political persuasion, no law enforcement profiling).

Diego: I can add the usage restrictions and open the PR for model_card + LICENSE. I'll also add a checklist item in onboarding.yaml requiring Legal signoff for custom licenses. @Sahil ping for tokenizer PR review.

Sahil: :thumbsup: I'll review. Also proposing small CI config to validate key fields in model config (pad_token_id != unk_id, kv_cache_compatibility: true). Minimal python asserts:
```
assert cfg['pad_token_id'] != cfg['unk_id']
assert cfg.get('kv_cache_compatibility', False)
```
Will add unit tests to the repo.

Jordan: Awesome — final gating for this model should be:
- model_card.md with attribution + usage restrictions
- LICENSE file present and clear about commercial use
- tokenizer normalization + unit tests passing
- config validation CI green
- security export-control & PII checks completed
- Legal signoff (comment on PR)
- Verify S3 location + checksum

Elaine: I'll do the legal signoff once the PR is up. ETA EOD today. Thanks all :rocket:
